sources: https://secure.rec1.com/WY/natrona-county-wy/catalog (Natrona County Parks Rec1 catalog, public getItems/getLocationFacilities JSON, read 2026-11-20): Alcova Reservoir tab: 'Alcova Reservoir offers both first come first served campgrounds as well as reservation only campgrounds.' / 'Restroom facilities are provided at each Alcova Reservoir Campground.'; group 'Westside (First Come, First Served)': 'First Come, First Served. $15.00 a night. Westside Campground is nestled between the Lakeshore Marina concession to the north and the Casper Ski Club to the south off of Lakeshore Drive. Campground information and pay boxes are located at multiple kiosks along the roadside of each Natrona County Park. The terrain is varied throughout this campground with areas of beach, rock, trees, or open area. Each camp site has a picnic table and a fire ring.'; facility 'Westside Non-Reservable Sites' Nightly Rate base fee $13.39 (before tax); a large reservable day-use shelter (group 'Westside Shelter')

Rec1 catalog Terms & Conditions (same page, read 2026-11-20): 'Each camping unit or individual is permitted to camp for a maximum of ten (10) days in any one campground. Upon the tenth (10) day, the camping unit must be removed or moved to a different campground other than the original campground.'; 'All camping permits start at 3:00 pm ... and expire at 11:00 am'; 'Call Parks Department office at 307-235-9325'
https://www.natronacounty-wy.gov/228/Westside-Campground and the site map it links (natronacounty-wy.gov/DocumentCenter/View/6451): not fetched (domain known to refuse with 403)
Google Maps place panel (2026-11-20): Westside Campground 4.5 stars from 26 reviews at 42.5271174,-106.777028

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (600 m and 220 m frames): the campground is the open gravel strip between Lakeshore Drive and the west shore, south of the marina; a row of camp spots with roofed shelters runs along the shoreline - an RV parked at ~42.5267,-106.7759 is ~10 m from the water, a shelter at ~42.5261,-106.7759 ~10-15 m, with only scattered single trees along the bank and open sand/gravel gaps to the water; the water edge sits at the vegetation line (no drawdown band visible); stored pin by the kiosk/entrance at the road

values.note: Pay at the roadside kiosk pay boxes. Permits run 3 pm to 11 am; after 10 days a camping unit must move to a different campground.

note: Natrona County campground on the west shore of Alcova Reservoir off Lakeshore Drive, between the Lakeshore Marina to the north and the Casper Ski Club to the south. Beach, rock, tree and open sites, each with a picnic table and fire ring, some with shelters; restrooms; no water or hookups. --Claude
